rules.statement: A co-owner is entitled to use a common lane for the purpose of reaching his land if by doing so he does not interfere with the substantial rights of other co-owners.
rules.supporting_quote: He is a co-owner of the lane and as such co-owner he is entitled to use it as a lane for the purpose of getting to his land on the east if by doing so he does not interfere with the substantial rights of the other co-owners.
